subject: Post-call: Buy motion & legal sequencing for Healtheon Labs
messages:
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Teresa Nguyen <teresa.nguyen@healtheonlabs.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@healtheonlabs.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (Buy motion & legal sequencing)

Teresa / Procurement — thanks again for carving out time this morning. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on sequencing: 

Call highlights:
- Use case: near-real-time document summarization for clinical intake forms; primary constraint is PII handling and retention policies.
- Desired go-live (pilot): early Q4 but procurement expects ~4–6 week review cycle.
- Key success criteria: latency < 300ms p95 for ingestion path, reproducible anonymization step, and SOC2 evidence for data handling.

Stakeholders we captured (please confirm any corrections):
- Economic buyer: Teresa Nguyen (Dir, Care Ops) — confirmed on call
- Procurement contact: procurement@healtheonlabs.com (procurement lead)
- Security/Privacy owner: Alyssa Chen (sec/privacy) — joined for 20m
- Legal reviewer: TBD (Procurement will nominate)

Proposed legal/contract routing (initial suggestion):
1) NDA (if required) — quick signature to enable deeper technical exchange (2–3 business days)
2) Security evidence exchange (SOC2 artifact + questionnaire) — parallel to NDA
3) MSA/DPA redline review — once security posture accepted; expect 7–14 business days for first pass
4) SOW negotiation and final signature — finalize scope & pilot KPIs

Action items I propose from Redwood: 
- Attach a one-page MAP and a draft SOW for pilot (I will send within 24h)
- Share SOC2 evidence package + short answers to your security checklist (we can do this by Friday)
- Draft an MSA redline template to speed legal review — pinging internal legal for a first pass

Questions for you: 
- Can procurement confirm the legal reviewer and their preferred review cadence?
- Is there a mandatory DPA template or specific clauses we must include for HIPAA/BAA?

Attachments referenced: Healtheon_postcall_notes.pdf (summary), preliminary MAP

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the MAP and SOW.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

From: Teresa Nguyen <teresa.nguyen@healtheonlabs.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@healtheonlabs.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@healtheonlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (Buy motion & legal sequencing)

Kimberly — thanks for the thoughtful recap. A few clarifications from procurement/security: 

- Procurement: our legal reviewer is James Patel (james.patel@healtheonlabs.com). Typical review cadence is 1 week for NDA/MSA initial pass but can extend depending on redlines; procurement prefers NDAs completed before sharing full test datasets.
- Security: Alyssa asked for our standard security questionnaire plus SOC2 Type II attestation and a list of encryption details (in transit, at rest). She also asked whether Redwood maintains access logs with user-level identifiers and retention windows.
- Data Privacy: we will need a DPA that references HIPAA BAAs (we operate with PHI in some flows). Procurement flagged that any vendor handling PHI must agree to our BAA terms; James will share the template.

Proposed timeline from our side: procurement kickoff this week, legal sync next Wed (3 Aug) if that works — otherwise, James will propose a date. For scheduling, we prefer morning slots (9–11 PT).

Please send the MAP/SOW and SOC2 artifacts — Alyssa will triage the security checklist.

Thanks,
Teresa Nguyen
Director, Care Operations
Healtheon Labs
teresa.nguyen@healtheonlabs.com

---

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: sequencing suggestion for Healtheon (NDA -> SOC2 -> MSA)

Kim / Marissa — quick internal note on sequencing and owner assignments before we send the MAP: 

- Sequence: NDA (if requested) -> Security evidence/Q&A -> MSA redline -> SOW, sign-off
- Owners: Legal intake/first-pass redline = Marissa (legal ops); Security packet delivery = Rishi (security enablement) with PM support from Kimberly; Commercial terms = Kimberly lead.
- Recommended turn times (target SLA): NDA: 2–3 business days; Security Q&A turnaround: 3–5 business days (we provide answers + artifacts); MSA first review: 7–10 business days (internal legal to prepare initial redline before sending to customer).
- Risk notes: Because they handle PHI, expect more stringent DPA negotiation; if they require BAA we need to loop security and legal early (possible 2–3 additional weeks). Consider proposing a limited pilot scope that avoids PHI to shorten cycle.

Attached: MSA_redline_initial.docx (internal template)

I’ll prep a compact MAP and send to Kimberly to forward.

Rishi
Sr. Security Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Teresa Nguyen <teresa.nguyen@healtheonlabs.com>, James Patel <james.patel@healtheonlabs.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@healtheonlabs.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed MAP & timing (NDA/SOC2/MSA) + request to schedule legal sync

Teresa / James / Procurement — attaching a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and draft SOW for the pilot. High level asks and proposed timeline below: 

Proposed MAP (summary):
- Day 0: Sign NDA (if needed) — target 2 business days
- Days 1–5: Exchange SOC2 artifacts + complete security questionnaire (Redwood delivers SOC2 package + answers)
- Days 6–15: MSA redline review (first pass by both sides; we provide initial redline)
- Days 16–25: SOW finalize + execution

Proposed signers / reviewers:
- Economic approver: Teresa Nguyen (Dir, Care Ops) and Mark Dutton (CFO, Healtheon) — please confirm
- Legal reviewer: James Patel — please confirm preferred contact method (DocuSign or tracked redlines)
- Security reviewer: Alyssa Chen — will own SOC2 intake and Q&A

Open items for procurement: 
- Please share your standard DPA/BAA template so we can reconcile; if they prefer specific language, we’ll highlight deviations in our initial redline.
- Confirm whether Healtheon requires in-country data residency for the pilot (this affects solution config).

I’ve uploaded the MAP + SOW to the customer Drive folder for review: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C (MAP is Healtheon_MAP_v1.pdf; SOW is Healtheon_SOW_v1.pdf).

If acceptable, can we schedule a 30-min legal-to-legal call on Wed, 3 Aug at 09:30 PT? I can loop our legal ops (Marissa) and security (Rishi) to join.

Thanks — attaching MAP & SOW stubs.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Kimberly — that timeline looks reasonable. James will take the MSA redline and share his comments during the legal sync. We confirm Wed, 3 Aug at 09:30 PT for a 30-minute legal review; please send calendar invite with the Drive links and initial MSA redline attached.

Two quick notes: 
- We do require a DPA with BAA language for PHI flows; James will upload the template to the Drive folder before the sync.
- For the SOC2 package, Alyssa asked that Redwood include a short operations note that lists retention windows and access-log retention (this helps our IR/compliance team).

See you on Wed.
